title: Ontra Mobility Wins Transport & Mobility Category at 2026 BE100 Pitch Competition
summary: Ontra Mobility wins the 2026 BE100 Transport & Mobility category at Blue Earth Summit in London, recognizing its work helping agencies plan better public transportation.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, NY October 17, 2026** – Ontra Mobility, an AI platform for transit planning, has won the Transport & Mobility category of the 2026 BE100 pitch competition at Blue Earth Summit in London.


The win follows Ontra’s selection among 100 companies chosen from 1,414 applications across ten industries. BE100 is Blue Earth’s global program to find, fund, and support pioneering businesses with the potential to transform their industries.


Ontra helps transit agencies answer a fundamental question: what service should we run? Its platform combines travel demand modeling, optimization, and simulation to help planners evaluate fixed routes, on-demand service zones, and frequency changes before committing resources. Agencies can compare service options against their budgets, fleet availability, operating constraints, and community priorities.


Transit agencies face difficult choices about where to invest limited resources and how to meet changing travel needs. Ontra brings those choices into a shared planning workflow, helping teams understand tradeoffs and develop practical service recommendations.


The BE100 category win marks a milestone for Ontra’s team and its mission to make public transportation more useful, accessible, and efficient.


Ontra Mobility congratulates all fellow BE100 participants -- companies that are doing important work to address climate change, protect the environment, and improve lives across a wide range of industries. It was inspiring to share the stage with this community of founders and innovators.


Ontra thanks Blue Earth, the judges, and HAATCH for their time, support, and commitment to helping these businesses grow. Thank you also to our agency partners, collaborators, and everyone who has supported Ontra Mobility along the way.


[See the Blue Earth announcement →](https://www.instagram.com/p/DejsTF4Df5M/)


## About Ontra Mobility


Ontra Mobility revolutionizes urban transit by providing a platform for cities and agencies to plan, integrate, and operate efficient, accessible, and sustainable bus, shuttle, and paratransit services. Their data-driven approach, developed by former Google engineers, optimizes routes and real-time dispatching to enhance ridership and reduce costs.
